title: Mexican chicken tortilla soup
steps: Chop the onion, garlic and chilli, sweat them in the oil for 4 minutes and add the cumin.
Add the tomatoes and stock, put in the whole chicken breast and simmer gently for 15 minutes, then remove and shred it.
Add the beans, sweetcorn and chicken to the soup and season with lime juice and salt.
Cut the tortillas into strips and bake at 200 °C for 6–8 minutes until crisp.
Serve the soup with tortilla strips, avocado and coriander.
